title: PH inflation yet to peak, says Citi

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — American banking giant Citi predicts that Philippine inflation will remain high through the first quarter of next year due to stagflation-like conditions and a slowdown in economic growth. In a media briefing, Citi predicts inflation could slow but will stay between 7.5 and 8.1 percent until early 2027 due to food supply risks and ongoing cost pressures.
